verdict.rationale: The evidence presents Workers as a managed service on Cloudflare's global network with 'no servers to manage'. The only nearby items are a local development and testing simulator powered by workerd, plus community comments about third-party self-hosted alternatives. A dev simulator is an adjacent capability, and neither item documents a first-party way to self-host the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
